text: My son is 2 months old. Temperature is 38.3°C, taken under the arm with a digital thermometer about ten minutes ago, and I've checked it twice. He was born at term and has been well up to now. This started this evening. He was a bit warmer than usual when I picked him up after his last feed and that's when I got the thermometer out. He's fed at his usual times today. I'm not after a long conversation. I've read that it's different when they're this little, and I've got no way of judging whether this number at this age is a wait-until-morning thing or a go-now thing. My partner thinks we're overreacting, I'm not sure we are. Please tell me straight which one it is and what we should do next. If we need to take him somewhere tonight, tell me where and I'll get the car seat in now.
